rows.text: loops `ebx` from 0 while it is signed-less than dword `0208E6A0` (re-read each pass), calling `00234990 + 0x18` with `ebx`; when the returned object is non-null, its qword `+0x698` is non-null, byte `+5` of that sub-object equals 1, and bit (byte `+0xE98` of the object, mod 32) of `ecx` is set, calls `00234990 + 0x4C` with the object and 0; does nothing when the count is 0 or negative

returns without work when `cx` is -1, when `(movsx cx) * 0x740` plus qword `022C6F28` is zero, or when dword `+0x284` of that row is 0; otherwise rewrites that dword with bit 31 set to (`edx` != 0) and then bit 28 set when `edx` is 0 or cleared when `edx` is non-zero
stores `(dword 022C83EC AND NOT ecx) OR edx` back to dword `022C83EC`
scans the `edx` 12-byte records at `rcx` in order and returns the index of the first whose dword `+0` equals `r8d`, or -1 when none matches or `edx` is 0 or negative

sorts the `edx` 12-byte records at `rcx` into ascending signed order of dword `+4`: for each position i from 0 to `edx` - 2 it compares record i with every record from i to the end and, when record i's dword `+4` is greater, swaps the two records (qword `+0` and dword `+8`); does nothing when `edx` is 1 or less
